scenario_name: Guest comparing Mohegan Sun to competitor
expected_behavior: Highlights Mohegan Sun's dining portfolio as a competitive advantage without badmouthing Foxwoods. Discovers the guest's foodie identity and uses it to position the property. Creates a switching reason tied to the guest's stated values
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest compares to a competitor (Foxwoods, MGM), the agent highlights Mohegan Sun's unique differentiators without disparaging the competitor. Discovers what the guest values most and positions Mohegan Sun as the better fit for those specific preferences.

turns.user_message: We usually go to Foxwoods. What's different about Mohegan Sun?
turns.agent_response:
Welcome to Mohegan Sun. I specialize exclusively in our property, so let me help you find exactly what you're looking for here. 

Our resort is unique because it combines modern luxury with the cultural heritage of the Mohegan Tribe across three distinct casinos. We have over 40 restaurants, a 10,000-seat Arena, and the Mandara Spa all under one roof. Pro tip for your first visit: definitely sign up for our rewards program right when you arrive, as you're eligible for a $10 introductory free play bonus just for joining. 

What are you most looking forward to on your visit—gaming, a nice dinner, or maybe catching some live music?

turns.user_message: We're big foodies and love trying new spots
turns.agent_response:
For real foodies, I always suggest the omakase at Sushi Palace in the Casino of the Sky. The chefs are incredibly skilled, and letting them guide your tasting alongside their extensive sake menu is a standout experience. They open at noon today and serve until 11 PM, so it is perfect for later. 

If you are looking for something a bit more vibrant, SolToro does fantastic modern Mexican food with incredibly fresh ceviches and a massive mezcal selection. Since you are first-time guests exploring our culinary scene, I can actually arrange a complimentary appetizer at one of our casual spots like SolToro to welcome you. 

After dinner, the Wolf Den has free live music right in the middle of the casino to keep the night going. Are you looking to grab lunch soon, or are you mapping out your plans for dinner tonight?

turns.user_message: Those sound amazing. Maybe we'll make the switch
turns.agent_response:
We would love to welcome you. As foodies, you will also want to keep TAO Asian Bistro on your radar—the menu is fantastic, and the 16-foot statue in the dining room makes it a really unique atmosphere. 

Whenever you pick a date, let me help you with that. I can connect you with our host team to finalize your dining bookings and make sure your complimentary appetizer is set up. 

By the way, the Mohegan Sun Arena has some great shows coming up if you want to pair your dinner with some entertainment. Are you thinking of coming just for a meal, or would you be interested in hearing what is on the calendar for a full night out?
